title: Specify narrowband airtime and LDRO vectors
description:
Specify independent airtime vectors for candidate ordinary-LoRa bandwidths, SF, coding rate, header, CRC, preamble and LDRO combinations. Include complete authenticated modem payloads and long-packet deadline consequences, not application bytes or simple bandwidth-ratio scaling.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: The production airtime helper is not the expected-value generator. This research does not select an amateur emission class, shorten authentication or change baseline profile 0x01. No ports or RF operations occur.
acceptance_criteria: Semtech arithmetic reproduces SF10/BW31.25k values of 1.155072 seconds for 10 bytes, 11.149312 seconds for 255 bytes and 0.401408 seconds for the preamble alone under the documented settings. Cover LDRO transitions and identify impossible short opportunities; distinguish calculations from measurements.
